lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct white vertical lines are visible; spacing is widest at the anterior shoulder and posterior haunch, with tighter clustering in the mid-lateral torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 6th vertical line (counting from anterior) splitting towards the ventral surface, and the 10th line bifurcating near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st, 2nd, and 3rd anterior lines terminate in the upper third of the torso; the 7th and 8th lines exhibit central discontinuities before reaching the ventral margin.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two isolated high-contrast white spots are located on the lateral posterior haunch, positioned approximately mid-way between the dorsal ridge and the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two posterior spots exhibit a horizontal linear alignment relative to the longitudinal axis of the torso.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron pattern on the bridge of the muzzle, two white spots on the lower malar region, and a large white patch on the ventral-anterior neck.
